name: Shi no Reien
source:
An accursed cemetery that places a curse on those who visit.

To the people who come visit on a dare, a fear unlike anything in this world lies in wait...

Will you be able to leave this cemetery alive?

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE050505.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
这是一座受诅咒的墓园，任何踏入其中的人都会遭到诅咒。

那些抱着试胆心态前来的人，将面对世间绝无仅有的恐惧……

你能活着离开这座墓园吗？

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE050505.html]DLsite[/url]]
